outlook.statement: The management is quite optimistic about the further growth of the company.

India is the largest consumer of gold in the world. Rising middle class population and increasing income levels are key drivers for demand of gold and other jewellery. Gold demand in India rose 11% year-on-year to 760.40 tonnes during January-December 2018. Government permitted 100% FDI in the sector under automatic route. BIS revised gold hallmarking standards from January 2018 to ensure quality check.
